usage.guide: Do not rely on this endpoint for transcription. In testing a paid call (POST with {audio_url: <public mp3>}) returned HTTP 200 and success:true with meta.upstreamPaid:true, but body.result came back as an empty object {} with no transcript text — money charged ($0.009), no usable output. A second attempt with a different body field was blocked by a strict shared rate limit (15 requests / 15 minutes, 429 with retryAfter:900). Treat as broken; if re-checking later, send {audio_url} pointing at a small public audio file and verify body.result actually contains transcript text before trusting it.
